title: Nashville Building Permits (Enriched)
description: Search Davidson County, TN building permits and applications, optionally joined to the ePermits contractor, owner, sub-trade permit, and inspection data. Or rank the contractors behind the matching permits.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `search` returns one row per permit. `contractors` returns one row per contractor, ranked by permit count and valuation across the matching permits.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: `issued` = permits already issued (date filter applies to issue date). `applications` = filed but not yet issued, an early signal (date filter applies to filing date). `both` merges them.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 90 days ago when no other narrowing filter is given.

dateTo.title: Date to
dateTo.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Defaults to today.

scope.title: Scope of work
scope.description: Preset classifier applied to the permit type, subtype, and description. Presets strip boilerplate (for example 'not to add a second kitchen') before matching.

keyword.title: Keyword in description
keyword.description: Free-text substring matched against the permit description on the server (case-insensitive). Combine with a scope or use alone.

address.title: Address contains
address.description: Substring of the street address, e.g. `1234 WOODLAND ST`. Metro stores addresses upper-case without unit numbers.

parcel.title: Parcel ID
parcel.description: Exact Davidson County parcel ID, e.g. `08309024300`.

applicant.title: Applicant contains
applicant.description: Substring of the applicant / contact on the open dataset (the paperwork filer, often the contractor).

permitNumber.title: Permit number
permitNumber.description: Exact permit number, e.g. `2026045225`. Use with `enrich` for a full case lookup.

permitType.title: Permit type contains
permitType.description: Substring of Metro's permit type or subtype description, e.g. `Residential - Rehab`, `Swimming Pool`, `Demolition`.

minValuation.title: Minimum declared cost (USD)
minValuation.description: Only permits with a declared construction cost at or above this amount.

maxValuation.title: Maximum declared cost (USD)
maxValuation.description: Only permits with a declared construction cost at or below this amount.

residentialOnly.title: Residential only
residentialOnly.description: Drop permits whose type or description reads as commercial.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Cap on rows returned (permits in search mode, contractors in contractors mode).

enrich.title: Enrich from ePermits
enrich.description: Join each permit to Metro ePermits: licensed contractor (name, license, phone), property owner, required sub-trade permits with satisfied/outstanding status, and inspection stage. About one second per permit, politely rate-limited. Billed as `enriched-permit` instead of `permit`.

enrichMaxAgeDays.title: Reuse cached enrichment younger than (days)
enrichMaxAgeDays.description: Enrichment fetched more recently than this is served from cache instead of re-querying ePermits. Set 0 to always refetch.

maxPermitsScanned.title: Max permits to rank over
maxPermitsScanned.description: Contractors mode only: how many matching permits (newest first) feed the ranking. Not billed; only the contractor rows are.

minPermits.title: Min permits per contractor
minPermits.description: Contractors mode only: hide contractors with fewer matching permits than this.
